title: AC1024 TABLE body-string cursor reconciliation
scope: Compare the ordinary ODA-layout parser path with a diagnostic byte-counted-body-string hypothesis on two TABLE records in the existing hash-bound AC1024 candidate. This closes only the local cursor-comparison action; it does not select a wire profile, change parser behavior, or qualify TABLE output.

authority.primary: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §§20.4.96.2, 20.4.97, and 20.4.99
authority.specifiedProfile: For AC1024, TABLECONTENT is embedded in ACAD_TABLE; a type-4 CadValue string uses TV, with R2007+ text in the detached string stream.
authority.conflict: The diagnostic body-byte-counted string hypothesis aligns the observed candidate cursors but conflicts with the specified type-4 detached-TV layout. ODA remains authoritative until an erratum or independent source-bound explanation resolves the conflict.

source.provenanceLimit: The checked-in SAVEAS script records the intended output versions but does not establish the executing application/build or base-drawing authoring/API state. The DXF pair is a semantic comparator, not a byte-identical encoding of the DWG cell stream.

diagnosticRun.pathBehavior: The primary ODA-layout path remains unchanged and fails closed on the candidate's decoded attribute-count/handle-role tail. The alternate interpretation ran on independent debug-only cursors and was not published.

candidateInterpretation.pairedDxfSemanticMatch: The paired ASCII DXF has a 7x3 ACAD_TABLE at handle 0x528 and first-cell value 'Table sample' with zero attributes.

secondCandidateInterpretation.pairedDxfSemanticMatch: The paired ASCII DXF has a 4x5 ACAD_TABLE at handle 0xa35 and first-cell value 'Hello this is a title' with zero attributes.

limits.strictOutput: The whole-file CLI still refused before publication because standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA has no qualified replay path.

result: The alternate interpretation reaches the declared body/string boundaries and the handle-stream byte boundary for both TABLE records after each R2010 postamble, with selected text matching paired-DXF semantics. This is strong local alignment evidence, not independent proof of the alternate wire layout. Keep the parser fail-closed and obtain authoritative clarification or a source-distinct producer-bound AC1024 TABLE witness before implementation. No fixture was added.
